notes: This contract records a portable installed-package C++ TCK case for querying ownership of one known, owned attribute. The scenario uses only official IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador declarations plus the C++ standard library. The adapter supplies provider library, FOM, endpoint, and callback configuration. It verifies one Inform Attribute Ownership callback with the queried object, attribute set, and current owner handle; unowned and RTI-owned results, invalid handles, MOM, and save/restore are outside this case.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador queryAttributeOwnership and isAttributeOwnedByFederate with FederateAmbassador informAttributeOwnership
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador ownership-query declarations
